E0503

Strings aren't indexable with `[ ]`

What

Strings aren't indexable with `[ ]`

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0503

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0503: tests/ui/string_index.stderr.

Error [E0503]: strings aren't indexed with `[ ]`
  --> tests/ui/string_index.jet:3:12
    |
  3 |     print(s[0])
    |            ^^^
 Why: text is counted in characters — walk them with `.chars()` or take a piece with `.slice(start..end)`
 Fix: e.g. `loop c in s.chars() { }` or `s.slice(0..2)`
